title: 第一卷 南域篇 第5章 借剑斩妖邪第一卷 南域篇 第6章 拂柳一剑三千气
slug: 剑问九州第1286章星域虫潮
content_zh:
“你找死！”黑蛛精方才毫无防备，被砸了个七荤八素，这会儿刚从渡河里爬出来，却见白泽还来，登时怒了。
八腿齐出，黑蛛精大喝一声，妖气流转，覆甲蜘蛛长腿尾端，硬刺寒光一闪，正面撞上彗星般飞驰而来的大青石！
“咔嚓！”
只听一声巨响，青石粉碎，坠落渡河，激起一人高的水花。
黑蛛精愣是被大青石块携带的怪力震退三步，两只脚都深深陷入了河床之中。
白泽速度奇快，五十余丈的距离转瞬即至。
“吃我太乙伏魔拳！”白泽踏水而行，一步下去，水花三丈高，信口胡诌，暗运紫阳真气，跳了起来，一拳直奔黑蛛妖面门而去。
“黄口小儿，欺人太甚！”黑蛛妖哇哇大叫，也是一拳递出，和白泽正面对上。
那一拳，蕴含道门无上绝学《太乙紫薇录》所炼化出来的至圣紫阳真气，端是的浑厚无匹，专克妖魔之气。
黑蛛精不料这一点，两拳相交，登时只觉凝如岩浆的浑厚真气至透他的心肺，登时倒退三步余，一口绿血喷了出来。
“你！……黄口小儿，怎有如此深厚之气劲？！”黑蛛精定睛一看，渡河对岸还有一高深莫测地老头，顿觉不妙，抽身欲退。
眼前之少年，不过十二岁余，竟有如此修为！那么与之同行的老者，岂非要远过之？
先前与柳灵争斗，他已是妖元大耗。如今再对不明之敌，实非上策。
就在黑蛛精想要逃遁的瞬间，谢玄忽然在河岸大喊一声：“徒儿，用为师传你的气运山河！这小蜘蛛要逃跑啦！”
黑蛛精一听老头是白泽师傅，不再多想，拔腿就跑。
“得嘞！”白泽右脚往河床一跺，紫阳真气注入地下，由于控制不准，其量过大，导致以白泽为中心，范围一丈之内的河水爆炸一般腾空而起，化为漫天水雾！
那气势，就连身中剧毒的柳灵都为之侧目。
“天地无极，道法自然！”白泽以紫阳真气探寻地下灵脉，可浑厚真气一出，居然只在河床仅仅寻得三条水脉！
可事至如今，别无他法，只得硬着头皮上。
这一手，别说镇锁山河，就是连天涯咫尺都无法做到！

“道门术法，气运山河！”白泽大喝一声，双手捏道门山河印。
顿见！
水龙之柱三条腾空而起，直奔夜空五丈余！
谢玄刚要叫好，只见其中一条水龙柱因引导不足登时溃散，跌入渡河，激起千层水浪。
白泽屹立不倒，身形却摇晃不止。
黑蛛精察觉身后有变，不敢回头，狂奔想要窜至渡河对岸的树林之中。
只要到了那里，以剧毒蛛网设下阻拦，他必然能够逃脱！
白泽控制两条水柱，只觉力不从心。水柱不断溃散，他只有一搏，双手合十，大喊一声：“吃你道爷一记太乙神掌！”
水龙柱登时化作两只巨大手掌，左右合击，拍向黑蛛精。
谢玄一句“妙极”还未出口，只见一掌突然崩毁，白泽随机应变，单掌按出，只见三丈余的巨掌顷刻追上黑蛛精，镇压而下！
“哗啦！”
阴影紧随而来，水声狂躁，黑蛛精猛然回头，但见巨大手掌兜头而来，将他以万钧之力狠狠地拍进渡河河床！
泥人尚有三分火，妖邪本就生性乖张。黑蛛精被一掌拍进河床，啃了一嘴泥沙。周身如被太岳压顶，之前被柳灵弄出的伤口登时鲜血淋漓。
血气上涌，黑蛛精双眼通红，他狂怒而起，历啸一声，“黄口小儿，受死！！”
content_en:
"You are looking for death!" The black spider spirit was unprepared and was beaten to pieces. Now it had just crawled out of the river, but when it saw Bai Ze coming back, it immediately became angry.
All eight legs came out, and the black spider spirit shouted loudly. The demonic energy circulated, and the hard thorns at the ends of the armored spider's long legs flashed with cold light, and it hit the big bluestone that was flying like a comet!
"Crack!"
There was a loud noise, and the bluestone shattered and fell across the river, causing a splash of water as high as a person.
The black spider spirit was shocked to take three steps back by the strange force carried by the big blue stone, and both of its feet sank deeply into the river bed.
Bai Ze's speed was extremely fast, and he could cover a distance of more than fifty feet in an instant.
"Eat my Taiyi Demon-Subduing Fist!" Bai Ze walked on the water, and when he stepped down, the water splashed three feet high. He was talking nonsense, secretly using Ziyang's true energy, jumped up, and punched straight towards the black spider demon's face.
"Yellow-mouthed kid, you're going too far!" the black spider demon yelled, and also punched out, facing Bai Ze head-on.
That punch contains the Holy Purple Sun Qi refined from the Taoist supreme skill "Taiyi Ziwei Lu". It is extremely rich and powerful and can specifically defeat the demonic Qi.
The Black Spider Spirit didn't expect this, so he fisted each other, and immediately felt the thick real energy condensed like lava penetrate his heart and lungs. He immediately stepped back three steps, and a mouthful of green blood spurted out.
"You!... Huangkou kid, how can you have such deep energy?!" The black spider spirit took a closer look and saw an enigmatic old man on the other side of the river. He suddenly felt something was wrong and wanted to retreat.
The young man in front of me is only twelve years old, but he has such a level of cultivation! Then shouldn’t the old man who was traveling with him have to stay far away?
The previous fight with Liu Ling had depleted his demonic energy. It is not the best strategy to face an unknown enemy now.
Just when the black spider spirit wanted to escape, Xie Xuan suddenly shouted from the river bank: "Disciple, use the luck passed down to you from my master to luck in the mountains and rivers! This little spider is going to run away!"
When the black spider spirit heard that the old man was Master Baize, he stopped thinking and ran away.
"Okay!" Bai Ze stamped his right foot on the river bed, and Ziyang Qi was injected into the ground. Due to inaccurate control, the amount was too large, causing the river water within a ten-foot radius centered on Bai Ze to rise into the sky like an explosion, turning into water mist all over the sky!
That momentum made even Liu Ling, who was poisoned, look at him sideways.
"The sky and the earth are infinite, the Tao is natural!" Bai Ze used Ziyang Qi to explore the underground spiritual veins, but as soon as the strong Qi came out, he only found three water veins on the river bed!
But now, there is no other way but to bite the bullet.
This move, let alone locking mountains and rivers, cannot even be done from the end of the world!
"Daomen's magic technique, Qi transports mountains and rivers!" Bai Ze shouted, and squeezed the Daomen mountain and river seal with both hands.
See you soon!
Three water dragon pillars soared into the sky, heading straight for more than five feet into the night sky!
Xie Xuangang was about to applaud, but one of the water dragon pillars collapsed due to insufficient guidance and fell into the river, causing thousands of waves.
Bai Ze stood erect, but his figure kept shaking.
The black spider spirit noticed something had changed behind her and did not dare to look back. She ran wildly and tried to reach the woods on the other side of the river.
As long as he gets there and blocks him with poisonous spider webs, he will definitely be able to escape!
Bai Ze controlled the two water columns, but felt powerless. The water column kept collapsing, and he had only one chance to fight, clasping his hands together, and shouting: "Take a Taiyi divine palm from your Taoist master!"
The water dragon pillar immediately turned into two huge palms, striking left and right together, hitting the black spider spirit.
Before Xie Xuan said "Wonderful", his palm suddenly collapsed. Bai Ze responded accordingly and pressed out with a single palm. The huge palm of more than three feet caught up with the black spider spirit and suppressed it!
"Wow!"
The shadow followed closely, and the water roared wildly. The black spider spirit suddenly turned around, only to see a huge hand coming from behind, slamming him into the river bed with great force!
The clay figurine still has three parts of fire, and the evil spirit is inherently perverse. The black spider spirit was slapped into the river bed and took a mouthful of sand. His whole body felt as if he was being pressed by Taiyue, and the wounds caused by Liu Ling were dripping with blood.
The blood surged, and the black spider spirit's eyes turned red.He got up in rage and screamed, "Young-mouthed kid, die!!"
